claim.value: Shared resources can contaminate a comparison pool.
claim.scope: Potential limitation of the proposed pool comparison.

provenance.rationale: P037 states the contamination possibility; P013 identifies the proposed comparison pool.

signal_basis.value: Lower concurrency in the canary pool and compare response trajectories with baseline and, where feasible, an unchanged pool with comparable scheduled work, recording shared-resource exposure and workload differences.
signal_basis.scope: Proposed concurrency experiment and pool comparison, assuming execution prerequisites are satisfied and the response is observed.

provenance.rationale: These spans supply the concurrency step, qualified comparison-pool design, exposure recording, and trajectory comparison.
No unresolved empirical relation is required to warrant this bounded possibility claim.

rationale: Changing canary concurrency can alter demand on resources shared with the comparison pool, affecting its performance despite unchanged settings. This licenses the stated possibility of contamination.
uncertainty: The packet does not establish whether contamination actually occurs or its magnitude; the claim asserts only that it can occur.
